pins.title: Paper flowers that bloom on water
pins.sub: A 5-minute screen-free craft with a secret message inside
pins.pin_title: Paper Flowers That Bloom on Water | Easy Screen-Free Craft for Kids
pins.desc: Fold a paper flower, write a secret in the middle, set it on water and watch the petals open by themselves. An easy rainy day craft and simple science activity for kids ages 5-10. Free printable template in our 3-project sampler. Image is an AI-generated example of the craft.

pins.title: Spin it and the bird flies into the cage
